description.value:
From Scary Monsters · Price: it needs a wound from your stand first.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: Raptor form: 1 action: your stand becomes a raptor until you spend 1 action to change back. It uses its own stand stats with these changes, based on the [Velociraptor](https://2e.aonprd.com/Monsters.aspx?ID=2915): Speed 40 ft, low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 ft; its primary attack becomes jaws (finesse) and its secondary becomes talon (agile, finesse), with their normal dice; it can use Leaping Charge (1 action: Stride up to 10 ft ignoring difficult terrain, then a jaws Strike with +2 circumstance to hit). In raptor form its Strikes tear: 2d6 extra damage on a hit (3d6 from 5th, 4d6 from 13th), and a creature it critically hits turns partly dinosaur for 1 round: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{confused} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2}. In raptor form it can't Interact or use any Stand Ability other than Dinosaurify. An integrated stand turns you into the raptor instead.
  • 5: Dinosaurified creature: Surge, 1 action: a creature your stand damaged this turn attempts a @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save (incapacitation). Failure: it becomes a dinosaur for 2 rounds; critical failure: 1 minute. A dinosaur keeps its level, HP, AC, saves and Perception, but it drops held items, can't cast spells or use manipulate actions, and its only Strikes are jaws (its best Strike's attack bonus and damage, finesse) and talon (same bonus, damage dice one size smaller, agile). Its Speed becomes 40 ft and it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2} from its animal mind. It attacks the nearest creature, including its own allies.
  • 9: Raptor minion: 2 actions: turn a Tiny animal within your stand's reach into a raptor minion with the Velociraptor's stats and the elite adjustments from GM Core (Creature 2) for 1 minute. It has the minion trait and takes 2 actions when you spend 1 action to command it. One raptor minion at a time.
  • 13: When you Act Together, your stand can give one action of its turn to command a dinosaurified creature to Stride or Strike (it can attempt a @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save each time to refuse). You can keep two raptor minions.
  • 17: A dinosaurified creature that critically fails stays a dinosaur for 10 minutes.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
